selection_rule: Maximum dev Evidence Hit@3, then dev Hit@1, then fewer chunks, then strategy name; freeze before test. No tuning on test.
audit_sampling: Coherence: first 10 (document_id,page) sorted lexicographically, source offset min(750,len(text)-1); all chunks covering offset. Metadata/grounding: all five test questions and top-3 for A/B/C.
